intentState.originalQuestion: Show the applications currently in my Licensing To Do queue.

knowledgeRequirementCoverage.reason: The To Do read contract binds the row entity to the application concept: id identifies the application entity, and page-scoped aliases (license request / طلبات الترخيص) denote that application entity, not licence entities or workflow tasks. The user manual confirms the To Do list is the current user's pending Licensing application workflow tasks.
requiredPoints: Each row represents a Licensing application (a submitted service request), not a licence certificate or a workflow task.
The application is the entity identified per row; the public row reference is the Application No. (applicationNumber).

knowledgeRequirementCoverage.reason: Application grain is id, and the To Do projection deduplicates by (id, dispositionCaseId); taskId is a separate workflow task unit. Distinct application counts can differ from projected workflow/disposition rows, so the list is one row per application entity at the requested grain.
requiredPoints: The list is at application grain: one entry per application entity.
A single application can carry multiple workflow task IDs over time, so task rows are not the same unit as applications.

knowledgeRequirementCoverage.reason: Personal scope is documented: tasks come from the authenticated user's task list, filtered by the endpoint runtime approval department, with no user-entered narrowing filter; the native My Tasks label is مهامي. The manual confirms scope is personal under current Applications page permission with the To Do tab active. The current user's identity and permission are runtime facts, not static knowledge.
requiredPoints: The queue is the signed-in user's own personal queue, not a team or department-wide list.
Membership comes from the authenticated account's task list filtered by the runtime approval department; a Manager role does not turn it into a team queue.
An empty result means nothing is routed to the user, not that the department has no work.

knowledgeRequirementCoverage.reason: The To Do view is defined: the pending population is the complete To Do queue from the MyTodoPage operation with its exact filter context, including pending modification and external approval as well as pending review, not only Pending Review. The page definition lists the todo view with label To Do and Arabic label قيد الإنجاز, distinct from the Completed tab and from the summary card count.
requiredPoints: The To Do tab selects the pending-work list on /licensing/applications (Arabic label قيد الإنجاز), distinct from the Completed tab.
To Do membership is established by the queue operation, not by a single generic row status literal; it covers pending review, pending modification and external approval work.
The To Do summary card is a separate count source and does not prove list completeness.
